name: red eye
source:
PLAY NOW! DESPAIR DAYDREAM NINETEEN.

“DDN? oh yeah, i’ve heard of it. it’s kinda a like, cult classic? lol.”

“i guess…? it got super popular on ticktock. people were trying it out because eternal nightmare fourteen was on a three day maintenance for the new expac.” 

“it’s really old so it’s kind of hideous but the designs are cute enough for commissioners.”

You're looking for something to fill the void of every day monotony. The grindset. Whatever.

Maybe she can help?

Your O So Glorious Raid Leader.

[From [url=https://happycat-games.itch.io/red-eye]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在就玩吧！绝望的白日梦十九。

“DDN？哦，是的，我听说过。它有点像邪教经典？哈哈。”

“我猜……？它在ticktock上非常受欢迎。人们正在尝试它，因为永恒的噩梦十四正在为新的expac进行为期三天的维护。” 

“它真的很旧，所以有点丑陋，但设计对委员来说足够可爱。”

你正在寻找一些东西来填补日常单调的空虚。磨具。任何。

也许她能帮忙？

你的哦，多么光荣的突袭领袖啊。

[来自[url=https://happycat-games.itch.io/red-eye]itch.io[/url]]
